prompt: A fantasy illustration of Matyas, a broad, muscular human male paladin with long white hair, dark skin, and striking red eyes, wearing black plate armor with a white surcoat bearing a cross symbol. He is lying on the ground in the dense jungle of Chult, having just woken up — his eyes are open wide with sleepy surprise and growing curiosity. His white hair is splayed out around him on the mossy jungle floor. Several chwingas — small, mysterious nature spirits from D&D 5e depicted as tiny hollow-faced wooden masked creatures with small limbs and leaf-like or shell-like adornments — are swarming around him. Some chwingas are tugging at his white hair with their tiny hands, fascinated by it. Others are leaning in extremely close to his face, their hollow carved masks nearly touching his nose, staring intently at his unusual red eyes. Matyas props himself up slightly on one elbow, expression shifting from groggy to amused and curious, watching the tiny spirits with wonder. The setting is a lush, humid jungle at dawn, with thick roots, tropical flowers, hanging vines, and dappled golden light filtering through the dense canopy above. The mood is whimsical, warm, and magical.
